ATO small business benchmark comparison
=======================================
Business type:  Barber and men's hairdressing
Benchmark year: 2023-24
Turnover:       not supplied (other business income was not evidenced)
Turnover band:  withheld until turnover is established

Ratio                                   This business  ATO range         Result
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Cost of sales to turnover               not supplied   -                 not_supplied
Total expenses to turnover (key)        not supplied   -                 not_supplied
Labour to turnover                      not supplied   -                 not_supplied
Rent to turnover                        not supplied   -                 not_supplied
Motor vehicle expenses to turnover      not supplied   -                 not_supplied

Figures used
  Sales of goods and services   not supplied
  Other business income         not supplied
  Total business income         not supplied
  Total expenses                not supplied
  Less payments to associates   $37,744.00
  Total expenses for the ratio  not supplied
  Cost of sales excluding wages not supplied
  Labour                        not supplied

Review outstanding
  2 account(s) still carry the bucket this tool suggested. Suggestions are made from account names alone and are not a substitute for reading the ledger.

Notes
  - 'Net profit' looks like a subtotal row but is mapped to motor_vehicle. The mapping wins, so check it is not double counting.
  - 2 mapping row(s) did not match any account in the export: Income, Profit and Loss
  - These buckets were omitted, not evidenced as zero, so their ratios are not_supplied: turnover, other_income, cost_of_sales, cost_of_sales_labour, salary_wages, contractor_commission, rent.
  - other_business_income was omitted. The ATO rule divides by sales, or by total business income once other income exceeds sales, so every ratio is not_supplied until that figure is established. The turnover figure, the basis that selected it, the turnover band, the published ranges and any note quoting that turnover are withheld for the same reason. Pass 0 only when the operator established the business had no other income.
  - 2 check(s) to make were withheld because one or more figures needed to state them were omitted rather than evidenced as zero.

Source
  Australian Taxation Office, Small Business Benchmarks, 2023-24 Benchmarks
  https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/591b444b-be7f-4121-8252-119a9fe07c19/resource/db3ab8b7-e029-48de-8e7a-c61532e25496/download/small-business-benchmarks-2023-24-data.xlsx
  Retrieved 2026-08-13, sha256 84925348cc6abfdbfb2cd14c62456e02d44057b7c7b444a6839e6179f71440f5

The ATO publishes these benchmarks as ranges, and sitting outside a range is not of itself a finding that anything is wrong. This tool reports a comparison. It is not tax advice and it does not decide how any amount should be reported.
